title: RAG in the Wild: On the (In)effectiveness of LLMs with Mixture-of-Knowledge Retrieval Augmentation
authors: Ran Xu; Yuchen Zhuang; Yue Yu; Haoyu Wang; Wenqi Shi; Carl Yang
why_relevant: Empirically analyzes RAG effectiveness under realistic mixture-of-knowledge retrieval, showing rerankers add little, no source dominates, and LLMs fail to route queries—motivating adaptive retrieval and when-to-retrieve decisions.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on effectiveness analysis rather than directly tackling adversarial or conflict robustness.
suggested_section: Calibration and Control: When to Retrieve
